assertions.assertion: States that v4 uses HybridCache for token caching (not the old IDistributedCache directly)
assertions.rationale: Explicitly states v4 caches with HybridCache, not IDistributedCache directly as in v3.

assertions.assertion: Explains the two-tier L1 (in-memory) + L2 (distributed) cache architecture
assertions.rationale: Describes L1 in-memory and optional L2 distributed (Redis) tiers and read fallthrough behavior.

assertions.assertion: Notes that explicit AddDistributedMemoryCache() registration is no longer required in v4
assertions.rationale: States no explicit cache registration is required in v4 for the default in-memory tier, unlike v3.

assertions.assertion: Mentions CacheLifetimeBuffer as a configuration option for controlling token refresh timing
assertions.rationale: Documents CacheLifetimeBuffer (default 60s) and its effect on early refresh.
